ladder.label: TOPPING
ladder.why: Daily momentum just crossed down and price lost its 10-day average mid-cycle. Last cycle was left-translated (topped early) — a bearish structural tell.
ladder.next: Trim or tighten stops; next likely support is the daily-cycle timing band (~day 36-42, now day 18).

ladder.regime_line: Bigger picture: MIXED — weekly momentum positive; last cycle left-translated (topped early) (investor cycle week 12 · daily cycle day 18).
ladder.summary_line: Short-term (daily): topping. Bigger picture (no clear trend): mixed.
points: Bigger picture is mixed (no clear trend for a daily long)

cycle_plain.daily_line: Daily cycle: day 18 of a typical 36–42 trading days

cycle_plain.weekly_line: Weekly (investor) cycle: week 12 of a typical 16–26 weeks
cycle_plain.weekly_phase: mid — the bigger up-leg is maturing

cycle_plain.weekly_phase_zh: 中期——更大的上行段正在成熟
cycle_plain.translation: The last cycle peaked in its FIRST half ('left-translated') — weak cycles top early, so this hints the bigger trend is tiring.

ladder.why_zh: 日线动量刚刚向下交叉，且价格在周期中段失守 10 日均线。 上一周期为左移结构（见顶偏早）——属于看空的结构性信号。
ladder.next_zh: 减仓或收紧止损；下一个可能的支撑是日线周期的时间窗口 （约第 36-42 天，现为第 18 天）。
ladder.regime_line_zh: 大局：混合 — 周线动量为正；上一周期左移（见顶偏早）（投资者周期第 12 周 · 日线周期第 18 天）。
ladder.summary_line_zh: 短期（日线）：做顶中。大局（趋势不明）：混合。

ladder.liq_line_zh: 美国净流动性目前中性——对概率没有方向性影响。
ladder.age_line: ⏱ TOPPING signal triggered 1 trading day ago (~2026-06-12), switching from NEARING A LOW. Signal strength: moderate (score -50/100).
ladder.age_line_zh: ⏱ 做顶中信号于 1 个交易日前触发（约 2026-06-12），自接近低点切换而来。 信号强度：中等（评分 -50/100）。
ladder.eq_label_zh: 入场质量：强卖出/离场形态（-66）
ladder.eq_tip: How well-timed & low-risk THIS entry is — near the cycle high, a fresh momentum turn, and with-trend. Measured: entries near the pivot drew ~30% smaller drawdowns than chasers far above it — risk control, NOT a return forecast.
ladder.eq_tip_zh: 衡量当前入场的时机与风险——贴近周期高点、动量新近转向、且顺势。实测：贴近枢轴的入场，其回撤比远离枢轴的追高者约小 30%——这是风险控制，并非收益预测。
